“I have compassion on the multitude, because they have stayed with me now three days, and have nothing to eat.
If I send them away fasting to their home, they will faint on the way, for some of them have come a long way.”
Jesus therefore said to them, “Children, have you anything to eat?” They answered him, “No.”
So when they got out on the land, they saw a fire of coals there, with fish and bread laid on it.

translations.web: He looked, and behold, there was at his head a cake baked on the coals, and a jar of water. He ate and drank, and lay down again.
translations.bsb: And he looked around, and there by his head was a cake of bread baked over hot coals, and a jar of water. So he ate and drank and lay down again.
translations.kjv: And he looked, and, behold, there was a cake baken on the coals, and a cruse of water at his head. And he did eat and drink, and laid him down again.
translations.asv: And he looked, and, behold, there was at his head a cake baken on the coals, and a cruse of water. And he did eat and drink, and laid him down again.
